variants.code:
local function smooth(t) t=math.clamp(t,0,1); return t*t*(3-2*t) end
local u=1/1.8
local weights={Lighting=smooth(u/.7),Atmosphere=smooth((u-.30)/.7),ColorCorrection=smooth(u/.8),Bloom=smooth(u/.8),DepthOfField=smooth(u),SunRays=smooth(u)}
for section,attrs in pairs(_G.LightingResearchOriginal.Day) do
 for k,a in pairs(attrs) do
  local b=_G.LightingResearchOriginal.FivePM[section][k]
  local t=weights[section]
  if section=="Atmosphere" and (k=="Color" or k=="Decay") then t=smooth(u/.8) end
  local v=typeof(a)=="Color3" and a:Lerp(b,t) or type(a)=="number" and (a+(b-a)*t) or a
  for _,p in ipairs(c.ContinuousPresets:GetChildren()) do p[section]:SetAttribute(k,v) end
 end
end
game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.World.Skies.ContinuousSky.SunAngularSize=4

local hour=HOUR
local function smooth(t) t=math.clamp(t,0,1); return t*t*(3-2*t) end
local u=math.clamp((hour-16)/1.8,0,1)
local weights={Lighting=smooth(u/.75),Atmosphere=smooth((u-.2)/.8),ColorCorrection=smooth(u/.85),Bloom=smooth(u/.85),DepthOfField=smooth(u),SunRays=smooth(u)}
for section,attrs in pairs(_G.LightingResearchOriginal.Day) do
 for k,a in pairs(attrs) do
  local b=_G.LightingResearchOriginal.FivePM[section][k]
  local t=weights[section]
  if section=="Lighting" and k=="Brightness" then b=.5 end
  if section=="Atmosphere" then
   if k=="Glare" then b=1.25
   elseif k=="Haze" then b=3.0
   elseif k=="Color" then b=Color3.fromRGB(160,112,78); t=smooth(u/.9)
   elseif k=="Decay" then b=Color3.fromRGB(87,92,125); t=smooth(u/.9)
   end
  end
  local v=typeof(a)=="Color3" and a:Lerp(b,t) or type(a)=="number" and (a+(b-a)*t) or a
  for _,p in ipairs(c.ContinuousPresets:GetChildren()) do p[section]:SetAttribute(k,v) end
 end
end
game.ReplicatedStorage.Assets.World.Skies.ContinuousSky.SunAngularSize=4
